context_for_next_testing_agent: AlterEcho is a real-time voice transformation app using Web Audio API for client-side audio processing. New features tested: 10 voice profiles (Radio Host, Villain, Alien, Underwater, Megaphone, Whisper, Stadium, Telephone, Cave, Robot DJ) displayed as horizontal scrollable cards, device selection dropdowns for microphone and speaker, and echo as a separate toggle that works alongside any effect. All UI elements render correctly with proper testIDs. Profile cards are clickable and show active state with cyan border. Device dropdowns open/close correctly. Echo toggle works independently with level pills (OFF, L1, L2, L3) appearing when enabled. Backend provides basic health check and status endpoints. No authentication required. App URL: https://audio-engine-preview.preview.emergentagent.com
